title: Year 11 Earth and Environmental Science Module 2 – Plate Tectonics
description: A fast-recall review of NSW Year 11 Earth and Environmental Science Module 2. Questions use short answers and avoid multi-step calculations or extended writing.
course: NSW Earth and Environmental Science Stage 6
author: Generated with Classroom Jeopardy Quiz Maker

questions.prompt: What theory explains the movement of Earth’s large lithospheric plates?
What rigid outer layer is broken into tectonic plates?
What softer layer beneath the lithosphere allows tectonic plates to move?
What process occurs when one tectonic plate sinks beneath another?
What name is given to the boundary between two tectonic plates?
What observation about South America and Africa helped support continental drift?
questions.answer: Their coastlines appear to fit together.

questions.prompt: Matching fossils on continents now separated by oceans support what idea?
What symmetrical pattern on the ocean floor records reversals of Earth’s magnetic field?
What happens to the age of oceanic crust as distance from a mid-ocean ridge increases?
What process creates new oceanic crust at mid-ocean ridges?
Which scientist proposed continental drift in the early 1900s?
Which scientist proposed mantle convection as a mechanism for continental movement?
Which scientist is strongly associated with the idea of seafloor spreading?
Which two scientists linked magnetic striping to seafloor spreading?
questions.answer: Fred Vine and Drummond Matthews. Accept: Vine and Matthews.

questions.prompt: What research vessel drilled ocean-floor cores that helped test seafloor-spreading predictions?
What type of plate boundary occurs where two plates move apart?
What type of plate boundary occurs where two plates move towards each other?
What type of plate boundary occurs where two plates slide past each other?
At what type of boundary is new oceanic crust commonly formed?
At what type of boundary is oceanic crust commonly destroyed by subduction?
What long underwater mountain chain forms at many divergent plate boundaries?
What deep ocean-floor feature commonly forms at a subduction zone?
questions.answer: An ocean trench. Accept: deep-sea trench.

questions.prompt: What geological event is especially common along transform boundaries?
What volcanic landform can form where one oceanic plate subducts beneath another?
questions.answer: A volcanic island arc. Accept: island arc.

questions.prompt: What major landform can form when two continental plates collide?
questions.answer: A mountain range. Accept: fold mountains.

finalRound.prompt: What ocean-floor evidence shows new crust forms at ridges and moves outward on both sides?
finalRound.answer: Symmetrical magnetic striping. Accept: matching magnetic stripes on either side of mid-ocean ridges.
